about: The desktop client's look, read by `wfg serve --window --theme=<this file>` at start and again on F5. The tokens are the ones clients/console/styles.css declares, with the same values, so the window opens looking like the page and every difference from then on is one somebody made. Colours are #rrggbb; `type` scales every font; `refreshHz` is how often the window reads the engine; `row` is a row's height in pixels before `type` scales it. A token left out keeps its default; one misspelled is refused by name; a file that does not parse changes nothing, and the window says why on its status line.
